title: Japanese Yakitori Chicken Skewers
description: A classic Japanese dish featuring marinated chicken cooked to perfection on skewers. This recipe yields tender, flavorful chicken with a sweet and savory glaze.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, mirin, and sugar.
Add the chicken pieces to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Thread 3-4 chicken pieces onto each skewer, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill or grill pan with vegetable oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Brush the skewers with the remaining marinade during the last 2 minutes of cooking.
Transfer the skewers to a serving platter and garnish with green onions.
Serve hot with additional marinade for dipping, if desired.
